title: KnowledgeOps local synthetic peer adoption

tests.name: Complete regression suite and static checks

tests.conditions: 155 passed, zero skipped; 39 additional tests. Isolated PostgreSQL with restricted runtime role. Includes unchanged 30-case citation/abstention regression and 67 vendor file hashes. Two dependency deprecation warnings.

costs.method: Deterministic extraction and recorded replay make zero provider calls. Infrastructure cost is unmeasured.
One canonical synthetic AgentOps operation, observed twice with the same identity/decision. Modeled USD 0.000113, zero provider calls; simulated ledger value is not actual spend.

skills.name: Canonical API contracts and permission-filtered exact citations
Constrained synthetic peer routing with typed unavailable outcomes

limits: Local component integration only; default workflows are not connected, and production retains the prior API format.
No new image/scan, frontend adoption, HTTPS/proxy cutover, load benchmark or deployed verification for this source.
FlowOps uses its actual PeerClient with unpersisted synthetic context; this is not an end-to-end refund or approval workflow.
KnowledgeOps AgentOps caller is disabled by default and accepts only a fixed empty-context synthetic exercise. Private content and live/paid inference remain unsupported.
LOW/PUBLIC describe the empty-context fixture only; the existing FlowOps HIGH/context-bearing inference request remains outside AgentOps admission.
The coordinator check must accept canonical knowledge status OK; its ANSWERED/NO_RESULTS assertion does not cover a positive canonical response.
Trusted development credentials and fictional demo roles do not establish enterprise SSO or private-data readiness.
Simulated peer costs are modeled, not billed. Unknown remote outcomes retain no invented usage or cancellation guarantee.
Original 25 fixture versions and 30 evaluation cases are unchanged; two original fictional refund references add coverage, not refund authority.
Public source publication, independent review and full ecosystem workflow validation remain pending.
